_comment: Package registry for the loadout package manager. See build/ADDING_BINARIES.md for the workflow.

_schema.platforms: List of platforms where this package is valid: 'linux', 'macos', 'windows'. Default ['linux'] when omitted.
_schema.depends: Hard dependencies: package names (or @group refs) that MUST be installed alongside this one. Resolver auto-pulls them; skipping a hard dep of a selected pkg is an error unless --no-deps or --force.
_schema.recommends: Soft dependencies: package names (or @group refs) auto-pulled when available; silently dropped if skipped or unavailable.
_schema.archive: Path (relative to repo root, 'PLATFORM' placeholder allowed) to the archive this package extracts. For kinds 'runtime', 'font', 'data', 'python-base', and archive-bundle 'bin' packages. Verified by 'loadout doctor'.
_schema.install_to: Target install path. '~' expanded at install time; a leading '.local' maps to the un-dotted 'local' for --dest-dir trees. Together with 'sentinel' this opts a package into the generic runtime-archive installer.
_schema.sentinel: Path (relative to install_to) that must exist after extraction; missing sentinel records a FAIL. Together with 'install_to' this opts a package into the generic runtime-archive installer.
_schema.chmod_sentinel: If true, chmod 0755 the sentinel file after extraction (launcher scripts).
_schema.remove_before_extract: Path or list of paths (relative to install_to) removed before extracting, so stale files from a previous bundle never survive an upgrade.
_schema.relocate_token: Distinctive ASCII build-path token in a runtime archive's text files. Generic runtime install replaces it with the deployed install root after extraction; must be paired with relocate_root.
_schema.relocate_root: Package-relative subtree of install_to scanned for relocate_token. Restricts token replacement to package-owned files; must be paired with relocate_token.
_schema.missing_hint: Consequence string logged when the package's archive is absent from the platform dir.
_schema.optional: If true, the package is excluded from the 'all' / '@shared' / '@engineering-loadout' sweeps and installs only when named explicitly, via '@shared-all', or pulled by a group that lists it in members. This is the only gating field.
_schema.source: Source dir or file (relative to repo root). For kind='env'.
_schema.extra_links: List of {from, to} entries describing additional symlinks to create after the env is installed.
_schema.supports_layers: For kind='env': layer names (corp/site/project/user) the env supports for user overrides.
_schema.members: For kind='group': list of package names or @group refs the group expands to. Resolver expands recursively with cycle detection.
_schema.bins: List of bin/*.bz2 stems (without .bz2) owned by this package.
_schema.libs: List of lib64/*.bz2 stems exclusively owned by this package. Omit or leave empty for libs shared by multiple tools — those are always installed.
_schema.typelibs: List of typelibs/*.typelib files required by this package (documentation only; all typelibs in the dir are always installed).
_schema.wheels: List of Python package names whose wheels are bundled in wheels/ for offline uv tool install.
_schema.uv_tool: Base package name passed to 'uv tool install' for Python-based tools. Triggers install_python_tools().
_schema.uv_extras: Optional Python extras included in the uv tool requirement. Their locked wheel closure must be bundled for offline installation.
_schema.version: Version of the bundled binary or package. Empty string when the payload has no meaningful upstream version.
_schema.rolling_git: Clone URL for first-party rolling packages; './build/update' rebuilds the wheel from source HEAD and stamps 'version' with git describe.
_schema.version_url: Upstream URL './check-versions' (via build) queries for the latest release when the project is not on GitHub/PyPI.
_schema.version_pattern: Regex applied to the version_url response to extract the latest version string.
_schema.version_scheme: Version comparison scheme override for check-versions (e.g. 'date').
_schema.version_url_accept: HTTP Accept header sent with version_url requests.
_schema.version_url_ua: HTTP User-Agent override sent with version_url requests ('' = curl default).
_schema.pin_reason: Human-readable reason this package is pinned below the latest upstream release.
